scope: Default int64 millisecond codec and exact explicit scalar point unit arithmetic; selected seven V0 records only.
semantics: Named int64 types.Instant is a millisecond codec; zero is ordinary. All axes/ID/Reference/unit/profile/version are caller supplied.
Default codec wrappers reuse unchanged provisional TP bytes. Numeric-only extraction checks millisecond Z/Q, limits, integrality and int64 range; no reference mapping is implied.
Exact equal-unit identity may preserve ordinal/unknown unit spellings. Only unequal microsecond/millisecond scaling is implemented; unsupported pairs explicitly refuse without alias normalization.
Rational cancellation precedes multiplication, with bounded input/result magnitudes and at most10 extra fixed-factor scratch bits. General wider Z/fractional Q remain supported.
No clock/calendar/solver, guessed epoch/reference, temporal interpretation, affine-origin or interval-domain support conversion. Public names/API/wire remain provisional before V2 freeze.
